OFFICIAL GAZETTE
Elpidio Quirino, President of the Philippines, do hereby
1. There are hereby created an Accounting Office and
an Office of the Representative of the Auditor General to
handle the accounting and auditing work of the Philippine
Army, the said units to be composed of the following per-
sonnel at salaries set opposite each:
(a) Accounting Office:
1. One accounting officer
2. One accountant
3. Ore bookkeeper
4. Two clerks at P2,760 each
5. Two clerks at P2,400 each
6. Six clerks at P2,160 each..
7. Three clerks at P1,220 each
8. One stenographer
9. Fifteen helpers at P1,440 each
10. Fourteen helpers at P1,320 each
